title: Returned Payments on a Crestline Credit Card and the Returned Payment Fee
content:
A payment returned unpaid by the cardholder's bank is added back to the Crestline Credit Card balance for its full amount and stops counting toward any minimum payment.

## The returned payment fee

A returned payment fee is charged for the returned payment at the product's **repeat** returned payment fee when at least one returned payment fee — not reversed — posted in the 6 billing cycles before the posting date, and at the product's **first** returned payment fee otherwise. It never exceeds the minimum payment due on the most recent statement.

## Returned payment fee or late fee

| How the returned payment stands | Fee charged for the event |
|---|---|
| It leaves the statement's minimum unpaid after that statement's due date has passed | a late fee for the missed minimum; no returned payment fee |
| It was returned before the due date of the statement it was meant for and replaced by another payment by that due date | the returned payment fee only |

## Cases on hypothetical figures

- A 150 USD payment toward a statement with a 45 USD minimum is returned two days before the due date; the cardholder pays 45 USD again before the due date. The balance rises by 150 USD and a returned payment fee is charged; no late fee.
- The same payment is returned after the due date and nothing else was paid by the due date. The balance rises by 150 USD and a late fee is charged for the missed minimum; no returned payment fee.
- A returned payment fee would be 41 USD on a repeat, but the most recent statement's minimum due was 29 USD: the fee is 29 USD.
